title: Church of Our Lady of Mount Carmel (Ouro Preto)
geometryBasis: The curved front, inset belfry bases, rear volume and approach stair axis follow the exact OSM topology. The original postcard and heritage texts control the façade composition and its distinguishing relief, twin finials and stairs.
sectionBasis: Six main elevation levels are estimated from the 1923 front postcard relative to the measured width. The field is sampled before construction. Foundation and stair heights are adjusted to meet it without reshaping it.
limitations: The native postcard is monochrome. The pale plaster, sandstone trim, painted wood and terracotta are approximate colors, informed by historic materials.
Stone relief, carved escutcheon, tower crossfalls, rear openings and roof details are modeled at medium fidelity. No interior or garden furnishing is modeled.
The source field resolves the hill and slope. It cannot resolve individual steps or certify survey-grade positioning. The stair width, tread count and foundation contacts are estimates.
